svg.title: Guinea pig
svg.desc: Tricolor guinea pig with a compact tailless body, short limbs, rounded pinnae, broad head, and coarse layered coat. Biological basis: Guinea pigs are used in auditory, respiratory, infectious-disease, and nutrition research; unlike many mammals, they require dietary vitamin C.
